messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

A cited R&S product source for the exact VNA model and specifications, such as R&S ZNL20 being a 20 GHz 2-port VNA with 5 kHz to 20 GHz VNA frequency range and 3.5 mm male test port connector [13].
Product-data conditions for any R&S specification claim, including warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, because data without tolerance limits is not binding [1].
Comparable measurement conditions for both R&S and the competitor, because the AI server ecosystem mapping adds R&S solution leads but does not provide measurement conditions that can replace formal specifications [8].
Evidence that the AI use case is a real technical requirement rather than only a sales mapping, because the R&S solution mapping only represents sales / test-solution leads and not formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [2].
Independent market or adoption evidence if claiming AI market fit, customer adoption, supply-chain position, shipments, share, or ranking, because the ecosystem sources do not by themselves support market share, adoption status, supply-chain relationships, or R&S relationships [6].
Validation documents or defined benchmarks if using platform, production, supplier-share, price, delivery-time, or adoption claims, because the cited AI PCB upgrade sources lack definitions, samples, source validation, and verification documents for such claims [16].

- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 AI伺服器趨勢推升 [[PCB]] 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸，供應鏈全面翻新。

answer.text:
A cited R&S product source for the exact VNA model and specifications, such as R&S ZNL20 being a 20 GHz 2-port VNA with 5 kHz to 20 GHz VNA frequency range and 3.5 mm male test port connector [13].
Product-data conditions for any R&S specification claim, including warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal automatic adjustments, because data without tolerance limits is not binding [1].
Comparable measurement conditions for both R&S and the competitor, because the AI server ecosystem mapping adds R&S solution leads but does not provide measurement conditions that can replace formal specifications [8].
Evidence that the AI use case is a real technical requirement rather than only a sales mapping, because the R&S solution mapping only represents sales / test-solution leads and not formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [2].
Independent market or adoption evidence if claiming AI market fit, customer adoption, supply-chain position, shipments, share, or ranking, because the ecosystem sources do not by themselves support market share, adoption status, supply-chain relationships, or R&S relationships [6].
Validation documents or defined benchmarks if using platform, production, supplier-share, price, delivery-time, or adoption claims, because the cited AI PCB upgrade sources lack definitions, samples, source validation, and verification documents for such claims [16].
